(3n + 1)/(n + 2)：0.5, 1.33, 1.75, 2, … 越: (3n + 1)/(n + 2): 0.5, 1.33, 1.75, 2, … edging towards 3. This time the board computes the sequence itself, and the neighbourhood is centred on 3.
aₙ = (3n + 1)/(n + 2)，L = 3：测试给出 ε，交出 N。: aₙ = (3n + 1)/(n + 2), L = 3: the test gives ε; give N.
分子乘分母的倒数。: The numerator times the reciprocal of the denominator.
第 0 章的机器算得出任意多项，可它只会加和乘：从整数出发，算出来的永远是整数。: Chapter 0’s machine computes as many terms as asked, but it only adds and multiplies: starting from whole numbers, everything it makes is whole. A shrinking sequence like 1, 1/2, 1/3, … is out of its reach, term by term.
这一章的第一件新元件是<part-ref to=\"part:recip\"><: The chapter’s first new part is <part-ref to="part:recip"></part-ref>: it gives 1/a.
1/(n+1) 每一项都不是 0，却能小过任何给定的正数：这样的数列叫<wiki: No term of 1/(n+1) is 0, yet it gets smaller than any positive number named: such a sequence is an <wiki-ref to="infinitesimal"></wiki-ref>.
第一拍的下标是 0。: The index is 0 on the first tick.
1 + 1/2 + 1/4 + … = 2：无穷多项永远加不完，等号右边的 2: 1 + 1/2 + 1/4 + … = 2: infinitely many terms never finish adding, so what does the 2 mean? Only partial sums can be computed; the question is what they tend to.
部分和有极限，就说<wiki-ref to=\"series\"></wiki-: When the partial sums have a limit, it is a <wiki-ref to="series"></wiki-ref>, and the limit is its sum.
交出 1 + 1/2 + 1/4 + … 的部分和；测试给出 ε，交出它离 2: Give the partial sums of 1 + 1/2 + 1/4 + …; the test gives ε: give the N at which they come within ε of 2.
「越来越近」不能只看某一项：前面近了又跑远，就不算。要问的是从哪一项起一直近，不: “Getting closer” cannot rest on one term: close, then far again, does not count. The question is from which term on it stays close, whatever happened before.
先不管近不近，只看一串 0 和 1：最近这段连续的 1 从哪一项开始？: Leave closeness aside for now and look at a run of 0s and 1s: where did the latest unbroken stretch of 1s begin?
一件事可以<wiki-ref to=\"eventually\"></wiki-: Something can hold <wiki-ref to="eventually"></wiki-ref>, whatever the terms before it did.
输入最近一段连续为 1 从第几项起；这一拍为 0 时给 n + 1。: Where the latest unbroken run of 1s in its input began; n + 1 when this tick is 0.
输入每拍是 0 或 1：交出最近一段连续为 1 从第几项起；这一拍是 0 时交出: The input is 0 or 1 each tick: give where the latest unbroken run of 1s began; give n + 1 when this tick is 0.
这一拍是 1 时，开头和上一拍说的一样。: When this tick is 1, the start is what the tick before said.
输入本身就是 1 或 0，可以拿它在两个数里挑。: The input is itself 1 or 0: it can pick between two numbers.
0, 1, 4, 9, 16, …：相邻两项的差是 1, 3, 5, 7，一直在: 0, 1, 4, 9, 16, …: the gaps between terms are 1, 3, 5, 7, always changing, so no “add the same number each time” recurrence fits.
但第 n 项只和 n 有关。手上有了<part-ref to=\"count\": But the n-th term depends only on n. With <part-ref to="count"></part-ref> in hand, one more part comes in: <part-ref to="part:mul"></part-ref>, which multiplies two numbers.
第 n 项直接由 n 算出，不经过前面任何一项：这叫<wiki-ref to=\: The n-th term computed straight from n, through none of the terms before: this is a <wiki-ref to="general-term"></wiki-ref>.
交出 0, 1, 4, 9, 16, …：第 n 项是 n²。: Give 0, 1, 4, 9, 16, …: the n-th term is n².
项一拍只来一个，而前面所有项的和要用到每一项。寄存卡一次只记得一个数：这个数该是: Terms arrive one a tick, yet the sum of all terms so far needs every one of them. A register remembers one number at a time: which number should it be?
搭好以后，累加 Σ 成为一件元件。: Built, the sum Σ becomes a part.
Sₙ = a₀ + … + aₙ 叫<wiki-ref to=\"partial: Sₙ = a₀ + … + aₙ is a <wiki-ref to="partial-sum"></wiki-ref>; the partial sums form a sequence too, made by the recurrence Sₙ = Sₙ₋₁ + aₙ.
交出输入到这一拍为止所有项的和。: Gives the sum of every term of its input so far.
每一拍交出输入到这一拍为止所有项的和。: Each tick give the sum of every input term so far.
第三拍时，第一项还在不在？: On the third tick, is the first term still in?
这台机器按拍工作：第 n 拍，每个输入的<wiki-ref to=\"seque: This machine works in ticks: at tick n each input <wiki-ref to="sequence"></wiki-ref> hands over its n-th term, and the board computes afresh and gives the n-th term of each output. Ticks count from 0, so the first term is a₀.
板上还什么都没有。第一件元件是<part-ref to=\"part:add\": The board holds nothing yet. The first part is <part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref>: it adds two numbers.
数列逐项相加：和的第 n 项只取决于各数列的第 n 项。: Sequences add term by term: the n-th term of the sum depends only on the n-th terms.
第一次往板上放元件：一拍一项、逐项相加: The first part placed on a board: a term a tick, added term by term
三个输入数列逐项相加，交出它们的和。: Add the three input sequences term by term and give their sum.
把<level-ref to=\"tri\"></level-ref>里的每一层: Stack the triangles of <level-ref to="tri"></level-ref> into a pyramid, one layer each: how many balls are there once layer n is down?
部分和的部分和：每求一次和，数列就长快一档。: Partial sums of partial sums: each summing makes a sequence grow a degree faster.
交出三角形数的部分和：0, 1, 4, 10, 20, …: Give the partial sums of the triangular numbers: 0, 1, 4, 10, 20, …
把 0, 1, 2, 3, … 个球一排排摆下去，摆到第 n 排一共用了多少个？: Lay out rows of 0, 1, 2, 3, … balls: how many are there once row n is down? This time the sequence to sum is not handed over by the test.
0 + 1 + … + n = n(n + 1)/2：传说高斯小时候把这一串首尾: 0 + 1 + … + n = n(n + 1)/2: the young Gauss is said to have paired the ends of the row and seen it at once.
1, −1/2, 1/3, −1/4, …：一会儿在 0 的右边，一会儿在左边。: 1, −1/2, 1/3, −1/4, …: now right of 0, now left. Does it tend to 0 as well?
交出 aₙ = (−1)ⁿ/(n + 1)；测试给出 ε，交出它离 0 不到 ε: Give aₙ = (−1)ⁿ/(n + 1); the test gives ε: give the N at which it comes within ε of 0.
